scope: Existing-draw diagnostic only; unchanged match variance fitter, seeds, point estimator and full-call rejection. No new confirmation or public reporting change.

selection.rejected: Every original component_inference_psd call: 189 q0 and 5000 q1 calls, all four targets retained.
selection.comparison: First four fully successful calls in each q0 rejected cell (null_signal, weak_signal, multi_mode_diagnostic), and first four fully successful q1 one_mode_unequal_independent calls (same match-mass and dependence regime as rejected q1 cells).
selection.dense: All selected q0 calls; first 32 and last 32 original replication keys in each q1 rejected cell; every successful comparison. Selection does not use target-local results.
selection.excluded: Original variance-fit positivity failures are enumerated separately, not replayed or treated as rescued. Existing target-local failures remain in the original campaigns.

capture: Insert read-only export immediately before shared finish_component_covariance in a disposable exact-source copy. Read native q0 marginal moments and q1 target finalizers, then execute the original unchanged whole-call gate. Never repair a covariance matrix.
independent_checks: Rebuild mass-scaled scalar match design, target quadratic forms and collapsed outcome from original physical rows; check native ordering and influence actions.
Reconstruct q0 marginal variances from captured common Gaussian trace moments; q1 pair quantities, statuses, and interval endpoints independently from captured trace terms.

On the fixed dense slice replace stochastic traces by exact traces, then replace fitted aggregate variances by true DGP variances. These diagnose realized covariance estimates, not population sampling covariance.
Use independent deterministic quadrature and quartic ellipse extrema; preserve production 4000-draw critical values separately and do not interpret their finite Monte Carlo error as a formula defect.

Successful comparisons must reproduce old point estimates, covariance diagonals, q1 statuses, raw recenter and deterministic-quadrature intervals within 1e-8 scale-relative error. Original rejected calls must remain rejected at their recorded phase.
interpretation: Computability is not coverage validity. Weak/null and multi-mode exclusions remain unchanged. No coverage gate is applied to this outcome-selected replay; all coverage summaries, if produced, must be explicitly selected-sample descriptions. No automatic q choice, unrestricted variance claim, joint-control correction, ABI or Stata change is authorized by this audit.
